short: Therapy with Z, LLC provides inclusive, person-centered online psychotherapy for adolescents (13+), adults, and older adults. We specialize in anxiety, depression, trauma, chronic illness and pain, grief, and LGBTQIA+ affirming care, offering compassionate, evidence-based support tailored to each client's unique needs and goals. Telehealth services are available in Oklahoma, Florida, South Carolina, and Idaho.
license: Oklahoma (22645), Florida (TPSW7232), South Carolina (2089), and Idaho (9081435).
certs: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW); Board Certified TeleMental Health Provider (BC-TMH); Certified Massage Therapist (CMT); Certified Yoga Teacher (CYT-1000); Trauma-Informed Yoga Teacher (TIYT)
training: Master of Social Work (MSW); Bachelor of Science in Psychology; Associate of Applied Science in Pre-Nursing. Advanced training in clinical social work, psychotherapy, integrated behavioral health, crisis intervention, trauma-informed care, mindfulness, and complementary and alternative medicine.
integrative: Advanced training and certifications in complementary and alternative medicine, including meditation, mindfulness, yoga, and trauma-informed yoga. My integrative approach incorporates mind-body practices, evidence-based psychotherapy, and holistic wellness strategies to support emotional, psychological, and physical well-being, particularly for individuals experiencing chronic illness, pain, and stress.
pricing: Individual psychotherapy: $75 for 30-minute sessions or $150 for 60-minute sessions. Insurance is accepted through participating networks, with copays, coinsurance, and deductibles varying by plan. A complimentary 15-minute consultation is available.
long: Therapy with Z, LLC is an inclusive, person-centered online psychotherapy practice serving adolescents (13+), adults, and older adults. We specialize in anxiety, depression, trauma and PTSD, chronic illness and pain, grief and loss, stress and burnout, and LGBTQIA+ affirming care. Our integrative, trauma-informed approach combines evidence-based psychotherapy, mindfulness, self-compassion, and practical coping skills to support emotional well-being and personal growth. Telehealth services are available in Oklahoma, Florida, South Carolina, and Idaho.
